title: OMS & Worker Interview Guide
subtitle: 45 COR audit interview questions for OMS and workers
disclaimer: Ask each question as written. Record responses in the interviewee's words. Verify with documentation and observations. Do not coach answers.

questions.title: Health & Safety Policy
questions.prompt: Does the health and safety policy outline your responsibilities regarding health and safety?

questions.title: Purpose of the Health &
questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the health and safety policy?

questions.title: Hazard Identification
questions.prompt: Are hazards identified and formally assessed before work starts?

questions.title: Ongoing Hazard Assessment
questions.prompt: Are hazards re-assessed as the job progresses or as procedures or conditions change?

questions.title: Participation in Hazard
questions.prompt: Are you involved in assessing hazards for formal and ongoing hazard assessments? If not, who is?

questions.title: Hazard Control
questions.prompt: Are you involved in controlling the hazards, or told how the hazards will be controlled?

questions.title: Hazard Control
questions.prompt: How do you review, evaluate, and enforce recommendations for hazard control?

questions.title: Safe Work Practices
questions.prompt: Have you been involved in the development and/or review of safe work practices in the past 12 months?

questions.title: Safe Job Procedures
questions.prompt: Have you been involved in the development and/or review of safe job procedures in the past 12 months?

questions.title: Company Rules
questions.prompt: Where are the company rules posted or how are they made available to you?

questions.title: Enforcement of Company
questions.prompt: Give an example of how rules are enforced.

questions.title: Personal Protective
questions.prompt: Who provides specialized PPE?

questions.title: PPE Training
questions.prompt: Does the company provide training in the use of basic and specialized PPE?

questions.title: PPE Selection
questions.prompt: What criteria are used to select proper PPE for specific jobs?

questions.title: Preventive Maintenance
questions.prompt: How does maintenance meet regulatory and/or manufacturers' standards?

questions.title: Defective Equipment
questions.prompt: If equipment or tools are defective, what happens to them?

questions.title: Qualified Maintenance
questions.prompt: Is the individual who performs maintenance and inspection of tools and equipment qualified to perform this task?

questions.title: New Worker Orientation
questions.prompt: Is it mandatory for workers to receive a new-hire orientation before starting work?

questions.title: Mandatory Training
questions.prompt: Are mandatory training requirements verified or training provided before starting work?

questions.title: Job-Specific Training
questions.prompt: Do workers get training for specific jobs?

questions.title: Supervisor Training
questions.prompt: Do supervisors receive training in inspections and health and safety responsibilities?

questions.title: Knowledge & Competency
questions.prompt: Is there a system in place to measure knowledge and competency?

questions.title: Health & Safety Meetings
questions.prompt: Does the company hold health and safety meetings (excluding JOHS Committee meetings)?

questions.title: Participation in Meetings
questions.prompt: Do you attend?

questions.title: Two-Way Communication
questions.prompt: How do you encourage two-way communication in safety meetings?

questions.title: Workplace Inspections
questions.prompt: Are inspections performed as required?

questions.title: Corrective Actions
questions.prompt: Are identified deficiencies corrected promptly?

questions.title: Management Participation in
questions.prompt: Does senior management review and participate in the inspection process?

questions.title: Communication of
questions.prompt: How are inspection results communicated to workers?

questions.title: Incident Investigation
questions.prompt: When a serious or potentially serious incident occurs, is it investigated?

questions.title: Incident Reporting &
questions.prompt: Have you been trained in the reporting and investigation process?

questions.title: Near Miss Reporting
questions.prompt: Are you recording no-loss incidents (near misses)?

questions.title: Implementation of
questions.prompt: Are incident recommendations implemented in a timely manner?

questions.title: Communication of
questions.prompt: How are investigation results or findings communicated to workers?

questions.title: Emergency Preparedness
questions.prompt: Explain your role and responsibility in relation to the emergency preparedness (response) plan(s).

questions.title: Emergency Assistance
questions.prompt: If an emergency occurred, how would you get assistance?

questions.title: First Aid Coverage
questions.prompt: Are the required numbers of first aid personnel available on-site?

questions.title: Transportation to Medical
questions.prompt: If someone needed transportation to a medical facility, how would this be done?

questions.title: Previous Audit Action Plans
questions.prompt: After your last audit, was an action plan communicated and implemented?

questions.title: Legislative Requirements
questions.prompt: Do you regularly refer to relevant legislation as part of job planning?

questions.title: Legislative Rights &
questions.prompt: How does your company make employees aware of their legislative rights and responsibilities?

questions.title: Regulatory Reporting
questions.prompt: What are the company's regulatory reporting (WorkSafeBC) requirements?

questions.title: Joint Health & Safety
questions.prompt: Who is your JOHS Committee or Worker Representative, and how would you contact them?

questions.title: Committee Responsibilities
questions.prompt: Do you know what the JOHS Committee or Worker Representative does?

questions.title: Committee Participation
questions.prompt: Do you or any member of the committee participate in inspections, incident investigations, or the resolution of safety issues?
